name: impressBox launcher local API
about: The player asks the device-owner launcher to change settings only a device owner can change. The same file is hmdm-android docs/launcher-local-api.json and impress-player app/android/helpers/launcherApi/launcher-local-api.json; the contract test in each repository checks its code against it.

methods: Bundle run(String command, in Bundle args)

callers: run() answers only apps whose signing certificate SHA-256 is on the launcher's allowlist (release builds: the player, CN=Domas Velykis, A7A7EAE8911E7522D00CFD377D5DED6F2BBEEF629DF6A37BB3C97AEEA96BEA53). Others get CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED.

results.zone: String: the device time zone now
results.configTimeZone: String, absent when the HMDM configuration has none
results.localApiZone: String, absent when no zone was set through this API

args.zone: String: an IANA time zone id, or auto to give the zone back to automatic detection

results.zone: String: the device time zone now

setTimeZone.refuses: MANAGED_BY_CONFIG while the HMDM configuration sets a fixed timeZone (anything but auto or empty). While a zone set here is kept, the configuration's auto no longer turns automatic time zone back on.

args.enabled: boolean: automatic (network) time on or off

setTime.refuses: REFUSED while automatic time is on: call setAutoTime with enabled false first

args.reason: String, optional, written to the log

reboot.note: Answers OK first; the device reboots about 2 seconds later.

args.windowStart: int, windowed only: minutes after local midnight, 0-1439
args.windowEnd: int, windowed only: minutes after local midnight, 0-1439

setSystemUpdatePolicy.refuses: MANAGED_BY_CONFIG while the HMDM configuration sets a system update type other than the default
